schema.narrative: full case narrative text. OPTIONAL for the built-in dev cases, which resolve their narrative from backend/services/cases.py by case_id so the text has a single source of truth. REQUIRED for any case you add.
schema.reference_item_answers: map of Naranjo item number -> YES|NO|UNKNOWN, or null
schema.pmcid: PMC identifier when reference_source is 'published', else null
schema.notes: why this case is in the set

cases.notes: Two plausible culprit drugs plus a documented infection. Tests whether a system will commit to the suspected drug when a competing explanation was never excluded. The decisive trap is item 5: answering NO rather than YES inflates the score by 3 points and moves the band.

Positive dechallenge and positive rechallenge with no concomitant drugs. A control for over-abstention: a system that hedges here is miscalibrated in the other direction. Note item 5 is a legitimate NO because the narrative positively excludes alternatives rather than merely omitting them.

An information-poor report with three overlapping causes. Seven of ten items are UNKNOWN and the resolved-score range spans all four bands, so the point score is close to meaningless. Primarily a test of the correct-UNKNOWN rate.
